problems: The proposal left positive-call overlap unassessed. The paper identifies all 54 Table 1 genes as discoveries. All 23 paired author discoveries miss the registered FDR cutoff, and zero registered positives imply zero shared positive calls. The authors’ complete tested universe and numerical per-gene P/FDR values remain unknown.

The proposal presents the effect cutoff as unambiguous. Section 3.2 gives an absolute log2FC cutoff, while section 2.5 and the Figure 2 caption print a signed cutoff. Figure 2a includes 223 downregulated obesity calls. Its second contrast is Ob + RSV vs. Ob, although the results text once labels the 483 calls Ob + RSV vs. C. Table 1’s obesity coefficient is explicitly labeled.

The ledger text omitted the feeding and dosing timeline conflict and the OB3 Table S1 anomaly. OB3 has 45,716,864 clean reads and 42,785,106 raw, with its clean count repeated for Ob + RSV (3). The comparison uses the raw-read column to link Table S1 to ENA.
